tasks.label: Compilar AEMMT (javac)
args: rm -rf bin && mkdir bin && javac -d bin -sourcepath src -encoding UTF-8 $(find src -name '*.java')
tasks.detail: Compila todos os .java de src/ em bin/ usando javac com encoding UTF-8
